issues.description: The Farm.singFarmSong() method has conflicting return types across artifacts. The UML in the problem statement specifies singFarmSong():void (and the template implements public void singFarmSong()), but the solution implements public String singFarmSong() and returns the song text. Similarly, the helper singFarmSongVerse is void/printing in the template and void in the UML but returns String in the solution. This mismatch can confuse students about whether they should print the song (void) or return it (String) and may cause tests or the template usage to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution match the UML/template: change the solution's Farm.singFarmSong() to return void and print the song (not return a String), and change singFarmSongVerse to a void helper that prints the verse using the provided Animal parameter. Alternatively, if returning the song text is desired, update the UML and template method signatures to return String and document that singFarmSong() returns the composed song instead of printing it. Prefer aligning solution to the UML/template (void/print) to avoid breaking provided tests and expectations.
